fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a key material property that affects the weight and structural performance of the screed.

fields.name: thermal_conductivity
fields.rationale: Thermal conductivity is important for understanding the insulation properties of the screed.

fields.name: compressive_strength
fields.rationale: Compressive strength indicates the load-bearing capacity of the screed, which is crucial for its application as a flooring material.
